name: LinksTrackly
author: linkstrackly

sections.description:
LinksTrackly allows you to create custom short links, manage redirects, and track clicks directly inside WordPress.

It is a simplified WordPress edition of the LinksTrackly routing system, designed for marketers, affiliate users, and campaign managers who need fast and reliable redirection.

With this plugin, you can:

  • Create custom unique link codes
  • Redirect using 301, 302 or cloaked mode
  • Track clicks with device detection
  • Store click data with unique detection
  • Export click reports to CSV
  • Use basic traffic routing logic
  • Manage multiple destination URLs (Pro feature)

This plugin is ideal for:

  • Affiliate marketers
  • Performance marketers
  • Bloggers
  • Small businesses running campaigns
  • Anyone needing a simple redirect + tracking system inside WordPress

For advanced routing features such as geo targeting, device-based redirects, fraud detection, VPN blocking, postbacks, and advanced analytics, upgrade to the full LinksTrackly platform.

Upgrade to Pro

The full LinksTrackly platform includes:

  • Advanced traffic filtration (Bot / VPN / Proxy detection)
  • Geo-based redirect (Country / Region)
  • Device-based routing
  • Weighted rotator
  • Fraud detection & risk scoring
  • Postbacks (S2S)
  • Detailed reporting & analytics
  • Campaign cost tracking
  • Priority updates & support

Visit the LinksTrackly website to learn more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file via WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to LinksTrackly in the admin sidebar.
  4. Create your first tracking link.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin shorten URLs automatically?

No. You create custom unique link codes manually for full control.

Does it support multiple destination URLs?

The free version allows basic routing. Advanced multi-URL rotator and weighted distribution are available in the Pro version.

Does it track device type?

Yes. The plugin detects mobile and desktop devices using the user agent.

Can I export click data?

Yes. You can export reports in CSV format from the reports section.

Does it support geo targeting?

Geo targeting is available in the Pro version.

Is this suitable for affiliate marketing?

Yes. It supports tracking, redirect modes, and query string handling.
